title: Rory O'S'mores
author: Moose Flores
problems: Row 5 "form an ocean wave - robins by left hands and neighbors by right hands, balance & Rory O'More right · balance" can't start from where the dancers are: The robins cannot join left hands facing the way they do.
Row 6 "balance & Rory O'More right · slide" can't start from where the dancers are: Dancers in a wave must face across the line.
Row 7 "balance & Rory O'More left · balance" can't start from where the dancers are: Dancers in a wave must face across the line.
Row 7 "balance & Rory O'More left · slide" can't start from where the dancers are: Dancers in a wave must face across the line.
The progression after row 8 "neighbors balance & pull by right · pull by" doesn't work out: Couples 1 and 2 have not passed each other yet.
Row 6 "balance & Rory O'More right · slide" can't start from where the dancers are: Dancers are not in a straight line.
Row 7 "balance & Rory O'More left · balance" can't start from where the dancers are: Dancers are not in a straight line.
Row 7 "balance & Rory O'More left · slide" can't start from where the dancers are: Dancers are not in a straight line.
choices: Rory O'More spins one full turn in the travel direction (the usual styling).
The balance before each Rory steps toward the slide direction first.
A star with no grip named is a basket star (wrist grip).
A meltdown swing starts with 4 beats of right-shoulder round, then swings.
